title: Imported work orders: board displays off, Imported not a status filter
custom_preconds:
1. On the Work Orders QA build (Board View / Tech View on), signed in with Work Orders view permission.
  2. Seed / setup: have work orders in the Imported state at the location, plus eligible lead technicians and work orders in other statuses.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Work Orders page and select the Imported filter view.
  2. Look for the Board View and Tech View display options while Imported is selected.
  3. In Tech View and Board View, open the Status filter and look for Imported as an option.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • While Imported is selected, the Board View and Tech View display options are unavailable (only List is offered).
  • In Tech View and Board View, Imported is disabled as a Status-filter option.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders - Board View & Tech View); Work Orders Board View & Tech View Display Options Technical Implementation Plan (engineering tech plan .md, provided 2026-09-30), section 1.4 Clarifications; read 30 Sep 2026. Specified by the tech plan / Product clarification and not covered by the PRD stories.
